paras.en: Come on – Everybody's doing it. That whispered message, half invitation and half forcing, is what most of us think of when we hear the words peer pressure. It usually leads to no good—drinking, drugs and casual sex. But in her new book Join the Club, Tina Rosenberg contends that peer pressure can also be a positive force through what she calls the social cure, in which organizations and officials use the power of group dynamics to help individuals improve their lives and possibly the world.

paras.en: The idea seems promising, and Rosenberg is a perceptive observer. Her critique of the lameness of many public-health campaigns is spot-on: they fail to mobilize peer pressure for healthy habits, and they demonstrate a seriously flawed understanding of psychology. "Dare to be different, please don't smoke!" pleads one billboard campaign aimed at reducing smoking among teenagers—teenagers, who Text 1  desire nothing more than fitting in. Rosenberg argues convincingly that public-health advocates ought to take a page from advertisers, so skilled at applying peer pressure.
paras.zh: 这个想法似乎很有前景,而Rosenberg是一位敏锐的观察者。她对许多公共卫生运动的无力的批评切中要 害:它们未能调动同辈压力来促进健康习惯,并且表现出对心理学严重缺陷的理解。"勇于与众不同,请不要吸 烟!"一个旨在减少青少年吸烟的广告牌运动如此恳求——而青少年最渴望的就是融入群体。Rosenberg令 人信服地论证,公共卫生倡导者应该向广告商学习,因为他们在运用同辈压力方面如此娴熟。

paras.en: But on the general effectiveness of the social cure, Rosenberg is less persuasive. Join the Club is filled with too much irrelevant detail and not enough exploration of the social and biological factors that make peer pressure so powerful. questions.stem: The phrase "reneging on" (Line 3, Para. 1) is closest in meaning to____

options.A: condemning.
options.C: dishonoring.

questions.analysis:
【判型】题干 The phrase "reneging on" (Line 3, Para. 1) is closest in meaning to 直接问某短语
「意思最接近」，这是词义题的标志句式。
【拆句】结构简单：主语 The phrase "reneging on" + 系动词短语 is closest in meaning to + 留
空。无陷阱。
【定位】A deal is a deal—except, apparently, when Entergy is involved. The company, a major
energy supplier in New England, provoked justified outrage in Vermont last week when
it announced it was reneging on a longstanding commitment to abide by the state's strict
nuclear regulations.
君子一言驷马难追——但 Entergy 显然不在其列。这家新英格兰主要能源供应商上周宣布
将撕毁其长期承诺、不再遵守 Vermont 严苛的核监管规定，引发了该州正当的愤怒。
【选项】A)
答非所问
condemning 意为「谴责」，主语应是 Vermont 才说得通；可句子主语是 Entergy 本
身，逻辑反了。
B)
与原文相反
reaffirming 意为「再次确认、重申承诺」，与「Entergy 撕毁承诺、激起愤怒」的语境
正相反。
C)
✓ 正确
reneging on a longstanding commitment to abide by the state's strict nuclear regulations ↔
dishonoring
预判要的「违背承诺」类负面动词，四个选项里只有 dishonoring 同时具备负面极性与
「对承诺/约定」搭配，与原文等值。
D)
与原文相反
securing 意为「保住、确保」承诺被履行，与「撕约」相反；与下句 Instead, the
company has done precisely what it had long promised it would not 完全冲突。
通过签订2002年的协议,Entergy意图____
A) 获得Vermont监管机构的保护。
B) 寻求联邦立法机构的支持。
C) 获得其营业执照的延期。
D) 获得购买发电厂的许可。

questions.analysis:
【判型】题干 By entering into the 2002 agreement, Entergy intended to 问的是签 2002 协议
「打算做什么」，是对原文一处客观事实的转述。
27. By entering into the 2002 agreement, Entergy intended to____
[ A ] obtain protection from Vermont regulators.
[ B ] seek favor from the federal legislature.
[ C ] acquire an extension of its business license.
[ D ] get permission to purchase a power plant.

【拆句】By entering into the 2002 agreement 是 by + 动名词作方式状语，等于「通过签 2002
协议（这一动作），公司想要……」，重点在主句 Entergy intended to 后的空格。
【定位】The conflict has been surfacing since 2002, when the corporation bought Vermont's only
nuclear power plant, an aging reactor in Vernon. As a condition of receiving state approval for
the sale, the company agreed to seek permission from state regulators to operate past 2012.
矛盾自 2002 年起就在浮现——那一年公司收购了 Vermont 唯一的核电站，即 Vernon 一
座老化的反应堆。作为获得州方批准这笔收购的条件，公司同意（在 2012 年后继续运营
时）须征得州监管机构许可。
【选项】A)
偷换概念
obtain protection from Vermont regulators 把 Vermont 监管者塑造成「保护者」，
但原文里他们是 Entergy 须低头求许可的「监管者」，不是保护者。
B)
张冠李戴
seek favor from the federal legislature 把对象从「state regulators / Vermont
legislature」偷换成「federal legislature」；2002 协议是和州方谈的，与联邦无关。
联邦法院只是第 2 段提到的 Entergy 后来撕约的去向。
C)
答非所问
acquire an extension of its business license 是 Entergy 之后才追求的目标（2012 后
想继续运营），而非 2002 签协议时的目的；2002 协议本身换的是「收购批准」，「延
期」是它埋下的将来义务。
D)
✓ 正确
As a condition of receiving state approval for the sale, the company agreed to seek permission
from state regulators to operate past 2012
↔get permission to purchase a power plant
预判要的是「换取收购批准」，get permission to purchase a power plant 把原文条
件状语整段同义化，与预判逐字吻合。

options.A: managerial practices.
options.C: financial goals.

questions.analysis:
【判型】According to Paragraph 4 是细节题最经典开口，要求按段内事实回答。
【拆句】主干 Entergy seems to have problems with its ____。seems 是软化语气，但不改变事实
陈述性质；its 后接名词，提示选项都是名词性短语。
28. According to Paragraph 4, Entergy seems to have problems with its____
[ A ] managerial practices.
[ B ] technical innovativeness.
[ C ] financial goals.
[ D ] business vision.

【定位】A string of accidents, including the partial collapse of a cooling tower in 2007 and the
discovery of an underground pipe system leakage, raised serious questions about both
Vermont Yankee's safety and Entergy's management – especially after the company made
misleading statements about the pipe.
一连串事故——包括 2007 年冷却塔局部坍塌和地下管道系统泄漏的发现——引发了对
Vermont Yankee 安全性和 Entergy 管理水平的严重质疑，尤其是在公司就管道问题发表误
导性声明之后。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
Entergy's management ↔managerial practices
made misleading statements about the pipe ↔managerial practices
managerial practices 既同根替换了 Entergy's management，又承接了「误导性声
明」这一具体做法，是预判的精准对应。
B)
无中生有
technical innovativeness（技术创新性）在第 4 段毫无对应——事故描述的是「老旧 /
失修」，不是「创新与否」；段内没有任何关于创新的褒贬。
C)
无中生有
financial goals（财务目标）在第 4 段无任何痕迹，段落只字未提钱、收益或预算。
D)
答非所问
business vision（商业愿景）若说，也只能从第 6 段「申请 Pilgrim 延期 20 年」隐约
延伸，但题干 According to Paragraph 4 已锁段，跨段证据不算。第 4 段本身只谈事
故和管理。
在作者看来,Vermont案件将检验____
A) Entergy履行其所有承诺的能力。
B) 各州拼凑式监管的性质。
C) 联邦在核问题上的权力。
D) 各州在核问题上的权力界限。

options.A: Entergy's capacity to fulfill all its promises.
options.B: the nature of states' patchwork regulations.

questions.analysis:
【判型】In the author's view, the Vermont case will test ____ 实质要求转述原文那句「Vermont
案将测试什么」的论断，是有明确出处的细节题。
【拆句】主干 the Vermont case will test ____，前置状语 In the author's view。空格处是 test 的
宾语，选项均为名词性短语。
29. In the author's view, the Vermont case will test____
[ A ] Entergy's capacity to fulfill all its promises.
[ B ] the nature of states' patchwork regulations.
[ C ] the federal authority over nuclear issues.
[ D ] the limits of states' power over nuclear issues.

【定位】whereas the Supreme Court has ruled that states do have some regulatory authority over
nuclear power, legal scholars say that Vermont case will offer a precedent-setting test of how
far those powers extend.
尽管最高法院已裁定各州对核电确实拥有某些监管权，法律学者表示 Vermont 案将提供一
次具有先例意义的检验，看这些权力究竟能延伸到多远。
【选项】A)
答非所问
Entergy's capacity to fulfill all its promises 是第 1、6 段的话题，本段法律焦点根本
不在「Entergy 能不能守诺」上；况且 all 把范围放得过死。
B)
偷换概念
the nature of states' patchwork regulations 把测试对象偷换成「拼布式监管的本
质」；原文里 patchwork regulations 只是括号般的「担忧」，并非该案要测的内容。
C)
与原文相反
the federal authority over nuclear issues 把测试对象换成了「联邦的核监管权」；可
定位句明确说测的是 states' powers，方向完全相反。
D)
✓ 正确
how far those powers extend ↔the limits of states' power over nuclear issues
states do have some regulatory authority over nuclear power ↔
states' power over nuclear issues
the limits of states' power over nuclear issues 同时承接「states' power（主体）」
与「how far ... extend / limits（范围）」两层信息，与预判完全一致。
从最后一段可以推断出____
A) Entergy在其他地方的业务可能会受到影响。
B) NRC的权威将受到挑战。
C) Entergy将撤回其Plymouth申请。
D) Vermont的声誉可能会受损。

questions.stem: It can be inferred from the last paragraph that____

options.A: Entergy's business elsewhere might be affected.
options.B: the authority of the NRC will be defied.
options.C: Entergy will withdraw its Plymouth application.

questions.analysis:
【判型】It can be inferred from the last paragraph that ____ 是推断题的模板句式。
【拆句】It can be inferred from the last paragraph that ____ 是 it 形式主语 + that 宾语从句，空
格处填一个完整的陈述句。
30. It can be inferred from the last paragraph that____
[ A ] Entergy's business elsewhere might be affected.
[ B ] the authority of the NRC will be defied.
[ C ] Entergy will withdraw its Plymouth application.
[ D ] Vermont's reputation might be damaged.

【定位】Entergy runs 11 other reactors in the United States, including Pilgrim Nuclear station in
Plymouth. Pledging to run Pilgrim safely, the company has applied for federal permission to
keep it open for another 20 years. But as the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reviews
the company's application, it should keep in mind what promises from Entergy are worth.
Entergy 在美国还运营着 11 座反应堆，包括 Plymouth 的 Pilgrim 核电站。公司承诺会安
全运营 Pilgrim，并已申请联邦许可让该站再开放 20 年。但 NRC 在审核这份申请时，应当
掂量一下 Entergy 的承诺到底值几分。
【选项】A)
✓ 正确
as the Nuclear Regulatory Commission (NRC) reviews the company's application, it should
keep in mind what promises from Entergy are worth
↔Entergy's business elsewhere might be affected
Entergy runs 11 other reactors in the United States, including Pilgrim Nuclear station in
Plymouth
↔Entergy's business elsewhere
Entergy's business elsewhere might be affected 把作者对 NRC 的暗示（应慎审）合
规延伸为「Entergy 在别处的业务可能受影响」，且用 might 保留不确定性，恰与原文
should 的情态等量。
B)
过度推断
the authority of the NRC will be defied 说「NRC 的权威将被违抗」——原文恰恰是
作者敦促 NRC 行使权威，谁也没说要违抗 NRC；且用 will 把可能性钉死。
C)
与原文相反
Entergy will withdraw its Plymouth application 说 Entergy 自己将撤回 Pilgrim 申请
——原文里申请人是 Entergy（仍在推进），而真正被作者寄望约束 Entergy 的是
NRC；让 Entergy「自撤」与全文「Entergy 撕约扩张」的姿态相反。
D)
偷换概念
Vermont's reputation might be damaged 把 reputation 的所有者换成 Vermont；
原文第 6 段开头 its reputation in Vermont is already so damaged 中的 its =
Entergy's，受损的是 Entergy 在 Vermont 的声誉，不是 Vermont 自己的声誉。

paras.en: In the idealized version of how science is done, facts about the world are waiting to be observed and collected by objective researchers who use the scientific method to carry out their work. But in the everyday practice of science, discovery frequently follows an ambiguous and complicated route. We aim to be objective, but we cannot escape the context of our unique life experiences. Prior knowledge and interests influence what we experience, what we think our experiences mean, and the subsequent actions we take. Opportunities for misinterpretation, error, and self-deception abound.
paras.zh: 在科学研究的理想化版本中，关于世界的事实正等待着客观的研究者去观察和收集,这些研究者使用科学方 法来开展工作。但在科学的日常实践中,发现往往遵循一条模糊而复杂的路径。我们力求客观,但我们无法 摆脱各自独特生活经历的背景。先前的知识和兴趣影响着我们的经历、我们对经历意义的理解,以及我们随 后采取的行动。误解、错误和自欺的机会比比皆是。

Within the complex social structure of the scientific community, researchers make discoveries; editors and reviewers act as Text 3  gatekeepers by controlling the publication process; other scientists use the new finding to suit their own purposes; and finally, the public (including other scientists) receives the new discovery and possibly accompanying technology. paras.en: Two paradoxes exist throughout this credibility process. First, scientific work tends to focus on some aspect of prevailing knowledge that is viewed as incomplete or incorrect. Little reward accompanies duplication and confirmation of what is already known and believed. The goal is new- search, not re-search. Not surprisingly, newly published discovery claims and credible discoveries that appear to be important and convincing will always be open to challenge and potential modification or refutation by future researchers. Second, novelty itself frequently provokes disbelief. Nobel Laureate and physiologist Albert Szent-Györgyi once described discovery as "seeing what everybody has seen and thinking what nobody has thought." But thinking what nobody else has thought and telling others what they have missed may not change their views. Sometimes years are required for truly novel discovery claims to be accepted and appreciated.

与原文相反

【拆句】Paragraph 3 shows that a discovery claim becomes credible after it____：主从结构，

【定位】As a discovery claim works its way through the community, the interaction and confrontation
between shared and competing beliefs about the science and the technology involved
transforms an individual's discovery claim into the community's credible discovery.
随着一个发现性主张在社群中流转，围绕相关科学与技术的共享信念与竞争信念之间的互动

33. Paragraph 3 shows that a discovery claim becomes credible after it____
[ A ] has attracted the attention of the general public.
[ B ] has been examined by the scientific community.
[ C ] has received recognition from editors and reviewers.
[ D ] has been frequently quoted by peer scientists.

【选项】A)
偷换概念
the general public 指普通公众，而原文 the public (including other scientists)
receives the new discovery 强调公众是「接收方」，且 credible 的转化机制是「社
群」做的，不是「公众关注度」决定的。
B)
✓ 正确

the interaction and confrontation between shared and competing beliefs ↔examined
has been examined by the scientific community 把原文「在科学社群中经过互动
与交锋」用「被科学社群审视」精准转述，且包含完成时态对应 after it ____ 的时态
需要。
C)
以偏概全
editors and reviewers 只是原文 editors and reviewers act as gatekeepers 提到的若
干角色之一，并非 credible 转化的全部主体，把其中一环当全过程。

无中生有

A) 科学声明将经受住挑战。

【拆句】Albert Szent-Györgyi would most likely agree that____：主语是人名，would agree

【定位】Nobel Laureate and physiologist Albert Szent-Györgyi once described discovery as "seeing
what everybody has seen and thinking what nobody has thought." But thinking what nobody
else has thought and telling others what they have missed may not change their views.

[ A ] scientific claims will survive challenges.
[ B ] discoveries today inspire future research.
[ C ] efforts to make discoveries are justified.
[ D ] scientific work calls for a critical mind.

【选项】A)
张冠李戴
scientific claims will survive challenges 的观点来自 newly published discovery
claims and credible discoveries ... will always be open to challenge 这一作者本人
的陈述，而非 Szent-Györgyi 的引文。

thinking what nobody has thought ↔a critical mind
seeing what everybody has seen and thinking what nobody has thought ↔

Györgyi 引文最自然的一步引申。

paras.en: If the trade unionist Jimmy Hoffa were alive today, he would probably represent civil servants. When Hoffa's Teamsters were in their prime in 1960, only one in ten American government workers belonged to a union; now 36% do. 【主旨】语言文化是否存在普遍规律的反思
全文沿一条主线推进：自然科学一贯追求 a search for universal principles has characterized
the scientific enterprise，这一思路也蔓延到社会科学（语言、文化）；但 Russell Gray 等人的
最新比较语言学研究给这种『普遍性追求』泼了一盆冷水——Neither of these patterns is borne
out by the analysis, suggesting that the structures of the languages are lineage-specific
and not governed by universals。作者整体语气是审慎、反思的：既承认追求统一是科学传统，
也指出这种追求在语言文化上未必成立。翻译时凡涉及『普遍性 / universal』『统一 /
unification』等术语，要按这条主线统一基调，不能时而译作褒义、时而译作贬义。
【指代】Q46 中的 this impulse for unification 指代上文
this impulse 不是凭空冒出的代词，回到 a search for universal principles has characterized
the scientific enterprise 与 this quest for commonalities defines science 可知，它指的是『科
学一贯追求普遍原理 / 寻找共性』的那种冲动。翻译 Q46 时应把 this impulse for unification 还
原为『这种追求（科学）统一的冲动 / 这种寻找普适规律的冲动』，不能只译作模糊的『这种冲
动』。
Q47 中的 Here 指代社会科学领域

social sciences too，可知 Here = 在社会科学领域里。翻译 Q47 时应把 Here 还原为『在社会科
学领域 / 在这里（社会科学中）』，否则中文读者读不出『是哪儿』。

world's languages, music, social and religious customs and even history are governed by
universal features，可知讨论的是各种文化现象。译时建议补足『（文化现象中）独有的部分 / 共

The second 需要补出『第二种尝试 / 第二种研究』，不能光译『第二个』，否则中文读者不知道
是『第二个什么』。

of everything – a single generative equation for all we see.

one approach takes this impulse for unification to its extreme,（主干（主谓宾+宾补结构 take sth

后置定语，意为『许多语言所共有的（特征）』，译时按汉语习惯前移到 traits 前。
which are considered to represent biases that result from cognitive constraints.（非限制性定语
从句（修饰 traits）+ 嵌套 that 定语从句（修饰 biases））★采分→这些（特征）被认为代表着源
于认知限制的某种偏好（倾向），
难点：which 指代 traits，biases 在此是中性的『倾向』，result from = 源于
which 是非限制性定语从句的关系代词，指代前面的 traits（特征），译时可重起一句『（这些
特征）……』。be considered to do = 被认为／被视为做某事。biases 不是日常的『偏见／成
见』，在认知科学语境里是中性术语『（认知）偏好／倾向』，译『偏见』会带贬义、失真。
that result from cognitive constraints 是 that 引导的定语从句修饰 biases，意为『（这种倾
向）源于认知（上的）限制／约束』，前移译作『源于认知限制的（偏好）』。

【调序】插入语并入主语，分词状语接续，which 从句独立成句
调序三步走：① by Joshua Greenberg 这个插入语在汉语里直接并入主语，译为『由 Greenberg
提出的第二种尝试』；② identifying... shared by many languages 这一段分词状语紧跟主干
『采取经验方法……，（同时）识别出许多语言共有的（特征）』，其中 shared by many
languages 是后置定语，要前移到 traits 前。③ which are considered... constraints 这段非限制
性定语从句太长，硬翻成『被认为代表……偏好的特征』会很累赘，按汉语习惯重起一句『这些特
征被认为代表着……偏好，而这种偏好源于认知上的限制』，把嵌套的 that 从句也独立化。
【译文】由 Joshua Greenberg 提出的第二种尝试，采取了一种更注重经验观察的方法来研
究语言的普遍性：它识别出（尤其在词序上）许多语言所共有的一些特征，而这些特
征被认为代表了源自人类认知限制的某种（普遍）倾向。

(50) Chomsky's grammar should show patterns of language change that are independent of the
family tree or the pathway tracked through it, whereas Greenbergian universality predicts strong
co-dependencies between particular types of word-order relations.
【意群】Chomsky's grammar should show patterns of language change（主句一·主干（主谓宾））★采分
→乔姆斯基（提出）的（普遍）语法应当呈现出语言变化的模式，
难点：should 表预期『应当 / 应该』，grammar 在本文是术语『普遍语法』
Chomsky's grammar 不是字面的『乔姆斯基的语法书』，结合上文 a universal grammar 可
知，它特指乔姆斯基理论中的『（先天的）普遍语法』，译时建议补出『（普遍）语法』。
should 在科学论述里常表『（按理论）应当／应该（呈现出）』的预期，不要译『必须』。
patterns of language change 直译『语言变化的模式／规律』即可。
that are independent of the family tree or the pathway tracked through it,（that 引导定语从句
（修饰 patterns））★采分→（这些模式）独立于（语言）谱系树以及在谱系树中所追踪的
路径，
难点：be independent of = 不受……影响，it 回指 the family tree
be independent of sth = 独立于／不受……影响／与……无关，本处译『独立于／不依赖于』均
可。family tree 在语言学里专指『（语言）谱系树／家族树』，结合 Gray and his colleagues
have put them to the test by examining four family trees that between them represent
more than 2,000 languages 可锁定此义。tracked through it 中的 it 回指 the family tree，
过去分词短语作 the pathway 的后置定语，意为『在（语言）谱系树中追踪到的路径』，须前
移到 the pathway 之前。
whereas Greenbergian universality predicts strong co-dependencies（主句二·让步/对比连词
whereas 引出，主谓宾结构）★采分→而格林伯格（式的语言）普遍性则预言（语言之间）存在
强烈的相互依赖关系，
难点：whereas = 然而 / 而（表对比，不是『鉴于』），co-dependencies = 相互依赖
whereas 在书面语里就是『然而／而』，表前后两种观点的对比，不能译成法律文件里的『鉴
于』。Greenbergian universality 是『格林伯格（式）的（语言）普遍性』，与 identifying
traits (particularly in word order) shared by many languages 提出的观点对应，术语要前后
一致。predicts 是『预言／预测』，含『按该理论应当出现』之意。co-dependencies 中的前
缀 co- 表『共同／相互』，译『共变性／相互依赖（关系）』均可。
between particular types of word-order relations.（介词短语作 co-dependencies 的后置定语）★
采分→（这种相互依赖关系存在）于特定类型的词序关系之间。
难点：between... 是后置定语，前移译『……之间的（相互依赖）』
between particular types of word-order relations 作 co-dependencies 的后置定语，按汉语
习惯前移到 co-dependencies 前译为『特定类型的词序关系之间（的强烈相互依赖）』。
particular 不漏译『特定的／某些特定的』，否则采分点会丢。word-order 是固定术语『词
序』，不要拆开译。

【调序】whereas 译『而』连接两句，定语从句独立或前移
调序方案：① whereas 译为『而／然而』作两句之间的过渡。② 前一句的 that 定语从句较长（含
the family tree or the pathway tracked through it），独立成句译『（这些模式）应当独立于
（语言）谱系树以及（在该树中所追踪到的）路径』；其中 tracked through it 这个分词短语前移
到 the pathway 前译作『（在）谱系树中追踪到的路径』。③ 后一句的 between particular
types of word-order relations 作 co-dependencies 的后置定语，按汉语习惯前移到 co-
dependencies 前译为『特定类型的词序关系之间的强烈相互依赖』。
【译文】（按理论预期）乔姆斯基的（普遍）语法应当呈现出这样一些语言变化的模式：它
们独立于（语言）谱系树以及在该谱系树中所追踪到的（演化）路径；而格林伯格
（式）的语言普遍性则预言：在特定类型的词序关系之间存在着强烈的相互依赖
关系。

英语一真题(2012)
Directions:
Some international students are coming to your university. Write them an email in the name of the
Students’ Union to
1)extend your welcome and
2)provide some suggestions for their campus life here. You should write about 100 words on ANSWER
SHEET 2.
Do not sign your own name at the end of the letter, use “Li Ming ” instead.
Do not write the address. (10 points)
【参考范文 · 105 词】
写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范
Dear friends, On behalf of the Students' Union, I am writing to extend our warmest welcome to all of you. We
are truly delighted that you have chosen to study at our university.
To help you settle in quickly, I would like to offer a few suggestions. First, do visit the Academic Affairs Office
early to plan your courses. Second, joining a student club is a great way to make friends and learn about local
culture. Finally, whenever you meet any difficulty, please feel free to turn to us for help.
We sincerely wish you a rewarding and memorable time here. Yours sincerely, Li Ming
【参考译文】
亲爱的朋友们： 我谨代表学生会，向你们各位致以最热烈的欢迎。你们选择来我校学习，我们感到十分
高兴。
为帮助你们尽快安顿下来，我想提几条建议。第一，请尽早前往教务处规划好你们的课程。第二，加入一
个学生社团是结交朋友、了解本地文化的好办法。最后，无论遇到任何困难，都请尽管向我们求助。
我们衷心祝愿你们在这里度过一段充实而难忘的时光。 此致 李明
【第 1 段】身份句立欢迎。本段用"称呼＋身份起手"法：Dear friends 定关系后，用 On behalf of the
Students' Union, I am writing to extend our warmest welcome 一句同时亮明学生会身份与欢迎目

的，落实了第一个任务点 extend your welcome，再以 We are truly delighted 添温度。
【第 2 段】三点建议落地。本段用"分点给可操作建议"法：过渡句 I would like to offer a few

英语一真题(2012)
Directions:
Write an essay of 160-200 words based on the following drawing. In your essay you should
1)describe the drawing briefly
2)explain its intended meaning, and
3)give your comments.
You should write neatly on ANSWER SHEET 2. (20 points)

【参考范文 · 191 词】
写作无唯一标准答案，以下为达标示范
As is vividly depicted in the cartoon, a bottle has been knocked over on the ground between two adults, with
most of its liquid already spilled out. The man on the left, holding his forehead in dismay, sighs "It's all gone!",
while the one on the right grins broadly and cheers "Luckily there is still a little left!"
Simple as it is, the drawing conveys a thought-provoking message about attitude. Faced with exactly the same
situation, the two men react in totally opposite ways: one is trapped in loss and frustration, whereas the other
manages to notice what remains and stays hopeful. This tells us that it is not the circumstance itself but our
attitude towards it that shapes how we feel. A positive mindset enables us to find opportunity in difficulty,
while a negative one only magnifies our pain.
In my view, we should learn to be the man on the right. Life inevitably brings setbacks and losses, yet
complaining changes nothing. Therefore, whenever misfortune strikes, we had better focus on what is still left
rather than what is gone, so that we can move forward with courage and hope.
【参考译文】
正如漫画生动描绘的那样，两个成年人之间的地上有一个被打翻的瓶子，里面的液体大多已经洒了出来。
左边的人手扶额头、一脸沮丧，叹道『全完了！』，而右边的人却咧嘴大笑，欢呼『幸好还剩点儿！』。

漫画虽简单，却传递了一个发人深省的、关于态度的道理。面对完全相同的处境，两人的反应截然相反：
一个被损失和沮丧困住，另一个却注意到剩下的东西、依然满怀希望。这告诉我们，决定我们感受的不是
处境本身，而是我们看待它的态度。积极的心态让人于困境中看到机会，消极的心态只会放大痛苦。
在我看来，我们应当学做右边那个人。人生难免有挫折和损失，但抱怨于事无补。因此，每当不幸来临，
我们最好聚焦于尚且剩下的，而非已经失去的，如此才能带着勇气与希望向前走。
【第 1 段】开场客观描述。首段用 As is vividly depicted in the cartoon 起笔，一句总起交代打翻的瓶
子，一句用 while 对照 the man on the left 与 the one on the right 的相反独白，两句说清画面、不掺
议论，落实了『两三句客观描述』。
【第 2 段】主题句领起分析。第二段以 Simple as it is, the drawing conveys a thought-provoking
message about attitude 点破寓意，再用 whereas 拉出两人对比，最后用 it is not the circumstance
itself but our attitude 强调句升华成道理，正是『主题句点破再展开』。
【第 3 段】评论加对策收束。末段 In my view 亮态度，Therefore 引出 focus on what is still left
rather than what is gone 的做法，呼应寓意收尾，落实『亮态度加建议收尾』。

描述—释义—评论的图画作文

面向阅卷人的正式书面语
本题无具体收信人，属议论型图画作文，语域按面向阅卷人的正式书面语走：用完整句、正式
连接词，不用缩略口语（如 gonna）与网络语；无需称呼与署名，专注把描述、寓意、评论三
步说清楚即可。

态度决定我们如何感受处境

2. 评论：学做乐观的右边人
第三段要点：现实难免挫折与损失，与其抱怨 全完了！，不如聚焦 幸好还剩点儿。，带着勇气
